title: Austin's New Mayor Takes Oath of Office
summary:
*   A newly elected Mayor was officially sworn into office during a special ceremonial meeting.
*   The Oath of Office was administered by two Travis County District Court Judges.
*   The entire meeting was brief, concluding in just 20 minutes as it focused solely on the Mayor's swearing-in.
transcript:
Austin City Council

FRIDAY, NOVEMBER 9,2001
The City Council of Austin, Texas, convened in a Special Called meeting on Friday,
November 9, 2001. at the Austin Convention Center, Ballroom A, 500 Cesar Chavez Street.
Mayor Watson called the meeting to order at 2:15 p.m.
